question.worked_solution:
First, we evaluate the inner integral by integrating with respect to $x$, treating $y$ as a constant:    

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}[{\int }_{2}^{4}{x}^{3}{y}^{2}\,\text{d}x]\text{d}y & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{y}^{2}[{\int }_{2}^{4}{x}^{3}\,\text{d}x]\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{y}^{2}{[\frac{\,{x}^{4}}{4}]}_{2}^{4}\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{y}^{2}(\frac{256}{4}-\frac{16}{4})\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}60{y}^{2}\,\text{d}y\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we integrate with respect to $y:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}60{y}^{2}\,\text{d}y & =60{[\frac{{y}^{3}}{3}]}_{0}^{1} \\  & =60\cdot \frac{1}{3} \\  & =20\end{aligned}
$$
